'''May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (18 May)''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG [[Booster Draft]] tournament of [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] boosters held on Sunday 18 May 2003 at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, as part of MNSWCCG's "Road to States" series leading to the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-1291-26390">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Fifteen players took part. [[Derek Van Beusekom]] and [[Michael Raveling]], both playing Dark Side, each finished undefeated with four full wins, and Van Beusekom took first place by one differential point.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />

Raveling collected a $7.00 cash prize for going undefeated, defending a bounty that [[Nick Kolnik]] had placed on him. He drafted [[Lord Vader]], [[Baron Soontir Fel|Baron Fel]] and [[Saber 1]] for play and pulled a [[Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]] in his prize support.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" /> Across the weekend of 17–18 May, which also included the [[May 2003 Rochester, Minnesota tournament|Rochester tournament]] on Saturday, 24 different players competed, 12 of whom had not played in an MNSWCCG tournament earlier in 2003.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />
* '''Dates:''' 18 May 2003<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />
* '''Format:''' [[Booster Draft]] ([[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]])<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />
* '''Players:''' 15<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Derek Van Beusekom]]<ref name="pcf-1291-26390" />
